devdoc.details: A contract that manages elections for the Board of Directors (BOD).

ElectionUtils__DuplicateCandidates().details: Error thrown when duplicate candidates are detected

ElectionUtils__DuplicateVoters().details: Error thrown when duplicate voters are detected

ElectionUtils__InsufficientCandidates().details: Error thrown when there are insufficient candidates

ElectionUtils__InvalidCandidate().details: Error thrown when candidate validation fails

ElectionUtils__InvalidDates().details: Error thrown when date validation fails

ElectionUtils__InvalidSeatCount().details: Error thrown when seat count is not odd

ElectionUtils__NoEligibleVoters().details: Error thrown when voter list is empty

Elections__AlreadyVoted().details: The caller has already voted in this election.

Elections__BoardOfDirectorsNotFound().details: The BoardOfDirectors contract could not be located via the Officer.

Elections__ElectionIsOngoing().details: A previous election has not yet concluded.

Elections__ElectionNotActive().details: The election is not currently accepting votes.

Elections__ElectionNotFound().details: The election id does not exist.

Elections__NotEligibleVoter().details: The caller is not in the eligible voter list.

Elections__OfficerAddressNotSet().details: The officer contract address has not been configured.

Elections__ResultsAlreadyPublished().details: Election results have already been published.

Elections__Unauthorized().details: The caller is not authorized for this action.

Elections__ZeroSender().details: The caller (msg.sender) was the zero address when initializing.

EnforcedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is paused.

ExpectedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is not paused.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

params.seatCount: Number of BOD seats to fill.
params.title: Election title.

Initialized(uint64).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

castVote(uint256,address).details: Submits a vote for a candidate in an election

params.seatCount: Number of BOD seats (must be odd)
params.title: Election title

returns.electionId: The ID of the created election

returns._0: Array of winning candidate addresses sized to the seat count.
The number of votes recorded for the candidate.

getVoterChoice(uint256,address).details: Gets the candidate that a specific voter voted for.

returns._0: The address of the candidate voted for, or the zero address if they haven't voted.
True if the voter has already cast their vote.

params.ownerAddress: Address that will own the contract.

returns._0: True if the voter is eligible.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

publishResults(uint256).details: Publishes election results (only callable by contract owner after election ends)

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

__gap.details: Storage gap reserving 50 slots for future upgrades. Decrement when adding      new state variables above so the reserve stays constant and proxy slots don't shift.

s_electionIds.details: List of all election ids created so far.

s_elections.details: Stored election records keyed by election id.

s_nextElectionId.details: Id assigned to the next election created.

s_officerAddress.details: Address of the Officer contract used to locate BoardOfDirectors.

s_voteCounts.details: Vote count per candidate for each election.

s_votes.details: Per-election record of each voter's candidate choice.

devdoc.title: Elections

ElectionCreated(uint256,string,address,u.notice: Emitted when a new election is created.

ResultsPublished(uint256,address[]).notice: Emitted when election results are published.

VoteSubmitted(uint256,address,address).notice: Emitted when a voter casts a vote.

getElectionCandidates(uint256).notice: Returns the candidate list for an election.

getElectionEligibleVoters(uint256).notice: Returns the eligible voter list for an election.

getElectionIds().notice: Returns the list of all election ids created so far.

getElectionResults(uint256).notice: Computes the current top candidates for an election without publishing.

getElectionWinners(uint256).notice: Returns the winners of a published election.

getNextElectionId().notice: Returns the id that will be assigned to the next election.

getOfficerAddress().notice: Returns the address of the Officer contract used to locate BoardOfDirectors.

getVoteCount(uint256).notice: Returns the total votes cast in an election.

getVoteCounts(uint256,address).notice: Returns the vote count for a candidate in an election.

hasVoted(uint256,address).notice: Returns whether a voter has already voted in an election.

isEligibleVoter(uint256,address).notice: Returns whether a voter is eligible in an election.
